usedFor: Grist holds records you edit like a sheet, and Moco books “Create Incoming Payment” when “New Record” runs.

bestTemplate.name: “New Record” in Grist, then “Create Incoming Payment” in Moco
bestTemplate.why: A payment row added in Grist is booked in Moco, so the books follow the sheet.

watchOut: “Updated Record” in Grist also fires on edits, so using it with “Create Incoming Payment” can book a payment twice.
